preprocessing: Training means and ddof0 standard deviations for every X/Y; native priors transformed consistently. All model settings get the same standardised arrays and validation/test transformations. Global intercept, span=None.
selection: One lambda per full panel, selected by mean validation MSE normalised by training response variance. Different from the earlier per-asset L1 selector; primary target contrast is within each geometry/setting.
model: Frozen LassoModel.fit_reg_lambda_path; cutoff_fraction .4, threshold_t1.0, adaptive gamma1 floor.5, CLARABEL with ECOS fallback, warmup_period=None. Economic priors passed explicitly with apply_ols_prior=False; automatic uses existing selection/filter semantics. Record prior/sign conflicts rather than alter production behavior.
known_groups: Original sub_asset_class from frozen universe; generative groups labelled oracle. Compare GROUP row geometry to HCGL row geometry. FCGL comparison changes cluster-by-factor penalty holding learned groups/sign/adaptive specification fixed.
seeds: Same independent train/validation/test streams as E3_L1, fresh seed ranges and common innovations across profiles. No pilot/confirmation pooling.
metrics: Credit cohort MSE/bias, native full beta MSE, isolated one-population-factor-SD scenario MSE, normalised test MSE, training-estimated systematic/full covariance error. Paired seed effects for auto/economic minus zero within setting. Save per-asset betas, raw/effective centres, signs and cluster labels.
validation: Path vs standalone fit in every setting/target on a deterministic 12-asset fixture including multiple groups. Verify sign feasibility and transformed direct residuals. Mutated future arrays cannot change fits; corrupt errors and missing cells must be rejected. Pin source/prerequisite hashes. Save every warning/failure.
pilot_gate: 10 panels, 150 setting-target rows. Five seeds per profile. No failed fits or numerical discrepancies; report warnings and runtime. Then all 100 confirmation panels unchanged (50 per profile). Four worker processes allowed.
scope: Bounded group extension at n112 in original/removed-Credit profiles, not Cartesian repeat of every E3 axis. No package or legacy-result modifications; theory deferred.
amendment: After pilot v1 failed on 2 of 10 panels with CLARABEL exceptions, enable the package's existing ECOS fallback. Preserve v1 and repeat the entire pilot, then use fresh confirmation seeds. No outcome-driven change to cells, targets, tuning or metrics.
solver_observation: Wrap the unchanged private dispatch function observationally, recording each final solver/status and lambda index; restore it after each path. Record every fallback and warning. Cross-check 45 fixture fits and all 30 selected fits in the first pilot seed per profile against fresh ECOS solves.
